title: Current-agent coding correctness after journey metadata removal
hypothesis: The cleaned-up agent retains concrete implementation and verification behavior on recovery and multi-file coding tasks.
falsified_if: Any coding artifact fails its deterministic grader, required verification is missing, or protocol/prompt activation is invalid.
local_evidence: The user found inferred journey tracking unhelpful. Journey visuals, schema and validation were removed; concrete-change and verification guidance remains. Local Lua and Python suites pass, but live coding correctness has not been checked. The motivating initial overhead is recorded in /tmp/lca/logs/lca-20260907-113431-275908.log calls 1 and 2. No historical run is used as a control.

task_suffixes.simple_prompt: This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.failure_recovery: File scope: change only shipping/quotes.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.multifile_order_cancellation: File scope: change only orders/__init__.py, orders/api.py, orders/models.py, orders/repository.py and orders/service.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.

deterministic_outcomes: current prompt activation and protocol validity
decision_rule: Seed 907. One current arm, eight maximum runs: simple_prompt and failure_recovery smoke, then two runs on each of three scenarios (the runner requires two repetitions for calibration). Maximum $3 between-run standard-equivalent cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 600 active worker seconds. No retries; preserve failures and missing usage. Stop on smoke or activation failures. Any coding failure requires investigation; all passes justify further paired validation only. This characterizes current correctness, not pre/post equivalence, speed improvement, or adoption. Freeze source and fixtures in the campaign manifest and record a decision with every cell.
